title: What Is Java & Why Is It Used?
summary: Discover why Java remains the backbone of global enterprise software, financial systems, and mobile applications worldwide.
learningObjectives: Explain what Java is in simple, everyday language
Identify real-world systems built with Java (UPI payments, Netflix, Android)
Understand the basic 3-step cycle: write code, compile, and run
expectedOutcomes: Confident mental model of Java's role in modern software engineering

activities.title: What Is Java & Why Is It Used?

breakdown.whatIsIt: Java is a popular, human-readable programming language created in 1995. It lets you write clear instructions that any computer can execute safely and quickly.
breakdown.whyItMatters: Java is trusted by banks, UPI apps, and tech giants because it is secure, fast, and rarely crashes. Once you learn Java, you have a rock-solid foundation for any tech career.
howItWorks: You write instructions in plain English-like code in a .java file.
The Java compiler (javac) translates your instructions into universal Bytecode (.class).
The Java Virtual Machine (JVM) on any computer executes the bytecode smoothly.
keyTakeaways: Powers UPI payments, banking, and Android apps
Write once in .java, run everywhere via bytecode

activities.title: Hands-on Practice: Say Hello with Java

practice.title: First Greeting Assignment
practice.problemStatement: Write a complete Java program that prints: 'Hello! I am learning Java with LearnBySelf.' to standard output.
requirements: Include standard entry point: public static void main(String[] args)
Output must exactly match: Hello! I am learning Java with LearnBySelf.
practice.expectedOutput: Hello! I am learning Java with LearnBySelf.
hints: Make sure 'System' has a capital S.
Double-check that the string matches the requirement exactly.

interviewQA.question: What is Java and why is it so widely used in banking and enterprise software?
interviewQA.expectedAnswer: Java is an object-oriented, cross-platform programming language known for its robust security, automatic memory management (Garbage Collection), and high performance. Enterprise companies and banks trust Java because it provides long-term backward compatibility and proven stability under massive user traffic.
keyPoints: Platform independent via bytecode and JVM
Robust security and automatic garbage collection
Proven reliability for mission-critical enterprise systems
commonMistakes: Confusing Java with JavaScript (they are completely different languages)

activities.title: Confidence Checklist
